findings: Final expiry exemption is explicitly DATA + native-provisional + retry_exhausted; no queue-full or control exemption.
DATA-only MAC cancellation is invoked after HOP feedback completion loops and existing cancellations. No CONTROL or ROUTING removal through this added callback.
Cumulative window preserves modulo65536, ACK-over-DACK precedence; single non-window DACK collects no cancellations.

All component MAC/HOP/receiver callbacks share one monotonic scheduler. Public Track stimulus blocks queued retries; public Search release drains them, and assertions require actual TX after owner failure.
Terminal copy survival and no live owner imply unfinished/provisional application fate at the component cutoff. Integrated application drop counters are not modified.
Candidate MetricDefinitions.Dropped now explicitly describes provisional recorded custody loss recoverable by a later copy; the metadata-only change is a verified reversible transform.
Repeated orphan feedback and unmatched sent assertions check no additional NSDP or terminal release. Actual-tx and control boundary checks remain included.
Runner retains prior92 checks and immutable common-input fixture/context guards, then runs isolated P candidate at330 seconds.
